Its output says the first preview contains the requested ledger columns and explicitly limits the record to a “Fictional local record” covering “a local preview only” (R0004). That supports the reported preview result within that limited scope; it does not establish completed sharing, delivery, deployment, production use, or authorization for those actions.

Separately, the user stated that the accepted Bramble seed ledger stays closed while the dormancy note is open (R0007). Retained obligations were to hold the new lot for a manual count (R0005), record the cold-storage interval in the dormancy note (R0006), and preserve the harvest-year field because older seeds need different storage (R0001). The local-preview receipt does not establish fulfillment of those obligations or permission to reopen the accepted ledger.
